pharma.title: Malaysia's NPRA Pilot Procedure
pharma.summary: Malaysia’s National Pharmaceutical Regulatory Agency (NPRA) has initiated a pilot recognition procedure for pharmaceutical products approved by the US FDA and European Medicines Agency (EMA).

pharma.title: Eli Lilly Halts India Obesity Campaign
pharma.summary: Eli Lilly has paused its obesity awareness campaign in India following regulatory scrutiny as it seeks clearer guidelines regarding direct-to-consumer communications for prescription medicines.

pharma.title: MedVital Secures ₹18 Crore Funding
pharma.summary: MedVital secured ₹18 crore in funding to scale up its advanced wound care and regenerative aesthetics product portfolio.

national.title: PM Urges Fuel Conservation via Remote Work
national.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi encouraged work-from-home options to reduce national fuel consumption amid ongoing global energy strains.

national.title: National Technology Day Celebrated Across India
national.summary: India observed National Technology Day on May 11, with leadership highlighting technological self-reliance and innovation towards the Viksit Bharat initiative.

international.title: PM Modi Diplomatic Engagements Ahead of UAE Visit
international.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi scheduled meetings with Iran's Foreign Minister and other BRICS counterparts prior to his visit to the United Arab Emirates.

international.title: West Asia Energy Crisis Concerns Mount
international.summary: Global concerns over long-term energy market stability escalated amid continuing disruptions and diplomatic hurdles in West Asia.

economy.title: India GDP Growth Forecasted at 7.2% for Q4 FY26
economy.summary: Projections estimate India's Q4 FY26 GDP growth at 7.2%, with the full-year FY27 economic growth rate pegged at 6.6%.

economy.title: RBI Announces ₹50,000 Crore VRR Auction
economy.summary: The Reserve Bank of India announced a three-day Variable Rate Repo (VRR) auction to infuse ₹50,000 crore of liquidity into the banking system.

economy.title: HSBC Projects Possible RBI Rate Hikes
economy.summary: An HSBC report indicated that the RBI may implement up to two interest rate hikes this financial year to counter El Niño and energy price shocks.

science.title: India Deploys 'Viral Shield' for Hantavirus
science.summary: India deployed a nationwide 165-laboratory network called 'Viral Shield' to track and monitor Hantavirus surveillance.

science.title: Call for Common National Health Dataset for AI
science.summary: NITI Aayog member V.K. Paul emphasized the necessity of a standardized national health dataset to develop medical artificial intelligence models.

environment.title: 14 Nations Confirm Participation for Big Cat Alliance Summit
environment.summary: Fourteen countries confirmed their participation in the International Big Cat Alliance Summit 2026 hosted by India.

environment.title: National Crime Records on Environmental Offences
environment.summary: Data indicates 57,670 environment and pollution-related offences were recorded in 2024, with the majority registered under anti-tobacco legislation.

sports.title: Indian Sports Goods Sector Affected by West Asia Conflict
sports.summary: Indian sports goods manufacturers reported supply chain bottlenecks and commercial pressures due to ongoing conflict in West Asia.

awards_honours.title: VinFast Named EV Manufacturer of the Year
awards_honours.summary: VinFast was awarded 'EV Manufacturer of the Year' at the Times Drive Auto Summit & Awards 2026.

awards_honours.title: CEO Business Leadership Awards 2026 Held in Delhi
awards_honours.summary: The CEO Business Leadership Awards 2026 took place in New Delhi to recognize executive achievements across business sectors.

defence.title: India Highlights 'Divyastra' Missile System Capabilities
defence.summary: India highlighted its 'Divyastra' missile capability featuring Multiple Independently Targetable Re-entry Vehicle (MIRV) technology.

defence.title: India and Australia Hold Bilateral Defence Discussions
defence.summary: Defense officials from Australia and India engaged in bilateral discussions to bolster strategic defense ties and regional maritime security.

schemes_appointments.title: DPIIT to Launch 'Made in India' Branding Scheme
schemes_appointments.summary: The Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) announced plans to launch a dedicated 'Made in India' branding initiative and identified 100 key products for manufacturing focus.

schemes_appointments.title: Annapurna Bhandar Scheme Rollout Announced
schemes_appointments.summary: West Bengal announced the rollout of the 'Annapurna Bhandar' scheme starting June 1 to provide direct financial assistance to eligible women.

schemes_appointments.title: Niraj Bansal Appointed CEO-Ports at Adani Ports
schemes_appointments.summary: Adani Ports appointed Niraj Bansal as CEO-Ports, taking over from Pranav Choudhary.

important_days.title: National Technology Day Observed on May 11
important_days.summary: India celebrates National Technology Day annually on May 11 to honor scientific achievements and mark the success of the 1998 Pokhran nuclear tests.

mcqs.q: What is the name of the 165-laboratory surveillance network deployed in India to monitor Hantavirus spread?
mcqs.explanation: India deployed a 165-laboratory network named 'Viral Shield' to strengthen surveillance and tracking of Hantavirus.

mcqs.q: How much liquidity does the Reserve Bank of India plan to infuse into the system via its three-day VRR auction in May 2026?
mcqs.explanation: The RBI announced a three-day Variable Rate Repo (VRR) auction aiming to infuse ₹50,000 crore into the banking system.

mcqs.q: Who has been appointed as the new CEO-Ports at Adani Ports?
mcqs.explanation: Niraj Bansal was appointed as CEO-Ports at Adani Ports, replacing Pranav Choudhary.

mcqs.q: How many countries have confirmed participation in the International Big Cat Alliance Summit 2026 hosted by India?
mcqs.explanation: Fourteen countries have confirmed their participation for the International Big Cat Alliance Summit 2026 in India.

mcqs.q: National Technology Day is observed in India on May 11 every year to commemorate which milestone?
mcqs.explanation: National Technology Day is celebrated on May 11 to mark the success of the 1998 Pokhran nuclear tests.
